description.value: You gain the feedback force power without it counting against your powers known, and may cast it using Wisdom or Charisma as your forcecasting ability. When you cast it as your action and the target fails its save, you may apply your Double Strike Force-Empowered Self option. Additionally, whenever the power deals psychic damage that doesn't already include your Wisdom or Charisma modifier, you add that modifier (your choice, minimum 1) as extra psychic damage.
